verse.unicode: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥

transliteration.english: surat sabadh saakhee meree si(n)n(g)ee baajai lok sune ||

en.bdb: Awareness of the Shabad and the Teachings is my horn; the people hear the sound of its vibrations.

verse.unicode: ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਮੰਗਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੇ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: pat jholee ma(n)gan kai taiee bheekhiaa naam paRe ||1||

en.bdb: Honor is my begging-bowl, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I receive. ||1||
O Baba, Gorakh is the Lord of the Universe; He is always awake and aware.

verse.unicode: ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: gorakh so jin goi uThaalee karate baar na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: He alone is Gorakh, who sustains the earth; He created it in an instant. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਪਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਵਣਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਏ ॥

transliteration.english: paanee praan pavan ba(n)dh raakhe cha(n)dh sooraj mukh dhe'ee ||

en.bdb: Binding together water and air, He infused the breath of life into the body, and made the lamps of the sun and the moon.

verse.unicode: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: maran jeevan kau dharatee dheenee ete gun visare ||2||

en.bdb: To die and to live, He gave us the earth, but we have forgotten these blessings. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਪੀਰ ਪੁਰਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥

transliteration.english: sidh saadhik ar jogee ja(n)gam peer puras bahutere ||

en.bdb: There are so many Siddhas, seekers, Yogis, wandering pilgrims, spiritual teachers and good people.

verse.unicode: ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਾ ਤ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖਾ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: je tin milaa ta keerat aakhaa taa man sev kare ||3||

en.bdb: If I meet them, I chant the Lord's Praises, and then, my mind serves Him. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਕਾਗਦੁ ਲੂਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ॥

transliteration.english: kaagadh loon rahai ghirat sa(n)ge paanee kamal rahai ||

en.bdb: Paper and salt, protected by ghee, remain untouched by water, as the lotus remains unaffected in water.

verse.unicode: ਐਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥

transliteration.english: aaise bhagat mileh jan naanak tin jam kiaa karai ||4||4||

en.bdb: Those who meet with such devotees, O servant Nanak - what can death do to them? ||4||4||
